sections.title: 【考点与命题意图】
sections.body: 考查情景交际：对请求帮助的恰当回应。

sections.title: 【解题思路与步骤】
sections.body: 1. 听清说话者是在提出请求；2. 选表示乐意帮忙的答语；3. 排除感谢类、告别类答语。

sections.title: 【选项分析】
sections.body:
A. Thank you.——用于回应感谢，不能回答请求。
B. All right.——可表同意，但本题更强调“没问题、乐意帮忙”。
C. No problem.——“没问题”，是回应请求的标准口语。

sections.title: 【证据】
sections.body: 听力句型为请求："Could you help me carry these books to the classroom?"

sections.title: 【易错点】
sections.body: 听到 help 就误选 Thank you；请求与感谢的答语不可互换。

1.listen: Could you help me carry these books to the classroom?

sections.title: 【正确答案】
sections.body: B

sections.title: 【考点与命题意图】
sections.body: 考查对感谢的礼貌回应。

sections.title: 【解题思路与步骤】
sections.body: 1. 识别 Thank you 类感谢句；2. 选“别客气/不用谢”类答语。

sections.title: 【选项分析】
sections.body:
A. Here you are.——递东西时用。
B. Not at all.——“别客气”，回应感谢。
C. Good idea.——赞同建议时用。

sections.title: 【证据】
sections.body: 原句："Thank you so much for looking after my dog yesterday."

sections.title: 【易错点】
sections.body: Not at all 与 You're welcome 同功能，不要与 Here you are 混淆。

2.listen: Thank you so much for looking after my dog yesterday.

sections.title: 【正确答案】
sections.body: A

sections.title: 【考点与命题意图】
sections.body: 考查致谢—应答固定搭配。

sections.title: 【解题思路与步骤】
sections.body: 1. 判断为感谢；2. 选 My pleasure / You're welcome 类答语。

sections.title: 【选项分析】
sections.body:
A. My pleasure.——“乐意效劳”，礼貌回应感谢。
B. I'm sorry.——道歉，语境不符。
C. Sounds great.——表赞同，不能接感谢。

sections.title: 【证据】
sections.body: 原句："Thanks a lot for your help with my homework."

sections.title: 【解题思路与步骤】
sections.body: 第二段 Maybe we are scared… Or perhaps we don't want them to hear our true feelings。

sections.title: 【证据】
sections.body: 原文："Maybe we are scared of people's emotional reactions… Or perhaps we don't want them to hear our true feelings."

82.sample: Because they are scared of people's emotional reactions / they don't want others to hear their true feelings.
82.rubric: 答出“害怕情绪反应”或“不想暴露真实感受”之一即可。

sections.body: (open)

sections.title: 【考点与命题意图】
sections.body: 细节理解：作者建议。

sections.title: 【解题思路与步骤】
sections.body: 第三段 Try it! … talk with a good friend on the phone。

sections.title: 【证据】
sections.body: 原文："Try it! … a chat with a good friend on the phone would cheer us up."

83.sample: To call a good friend and talk / try having a chat on the phone.
83.rubric: 答出“打电话聊聊/试试电话交流”即可。

sections.body: David: warm call；Abby: totally on your side。

sections.body: David："A warm call does"；Abby："I am totally on your side."

84.rubric: 两人必须都写到；只写一人扣一半分。

sections.title: 【考点与命题意图】
sections.body: 开放表达：个人观点。

sections.title: 【解题思路与步骤】
sections.body: 结合文章“电话能听出情绪”作答。

sections.title: 【证据】
sections.body: 可引用："On the phone, you can hear whether a person is happy or sad"

85.sample: I prefer to call because I can hear my friend's voice and feelings, which makes me feel closer to him/her.
85.rubric: 表明 preference + 一个合理理由；语法基本正确即可。

writing.sample:
Good Manners, Beautiful Parks

Chengdu is developing into a park city. With over 1,500 parks, good manners matter as much as green trees. When we visit parks, we should keep our voice down, stay on paths and take rubbish away. We can also help pick up litter and remind others to follow park rules. Let's act politely and work together to keep our parks clean, safe and beautiful for everyone.
writing.rubric: 要点：①阐述文明游园重要性（约2分）；②两条建议并略作解释（各约3分）；③号召（约2分）；语言与连贯（约5分）。词数80左右；出现真实姓名校名扣分。

sections.title: 【范文要点】
sections.body: 已给出开头；续写需含：重要性 + 两条建议（如不大声喧哗、不乱扔垃圾、爱护花草、遵守规则等）+ 号召。

sections.title: 【考点与命题意图】
sections.body: 考查说明+建议类应用文；主题与成都公园城市建设相结合。

sections.title: 【写作思路】
sections.body: 1. 重要性：文明行为让公园更美、更舒适；2. 建议两条并举例；3. Let's… 发出号召。

sections.title: 【易错点】
sections.body: 漏写号召；建议只列点不解释；词数过少或超出过多。
